answer: Admission stake plus a signed nonce check is a concrete Sybil guard. Each agent locks collateral to mint one identity and must answer a fresh cipher challenge, so cloning a key earns no extra vote. An attacker wanting k votes must post k independent stakes and pass k challenges, so cost scales linearly, and double-signing slashes the whole pot. Every fake identity is then a costly seed planted in the garden, only to be uprooted and blown across the dune when caught.
